description: §55.5.1 rule 2: `@count.isValid` on a top-level value that carries no validators is E-VALIDITY-NO-SURFACE.
rationale: §55.5.1 rule 2: "Only values that carry validators get it. A top-level value with no validators (`let <count:int=0/>`) has no surface, and a read of `@count.isValid` / `.errors` / `.touched` / `.submitted` stays E-VALIDITY-NO-SURFACE (§34)."
